page_title: FRE 3-1 MON | Freiburg v B. Monchengladbach 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Freiburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Holer departs the field of play to be replaced by Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg).
89' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Ritsu Doan is replaced by Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
88' Freiburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' B. Monchengladbach failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

87' The ball from the corner kick lands at the feet of Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) just outside the box, who takes a shot. The strike heads towards the left post, but it's deflected away thanks to a wonderful intervention by one of the defenders. B. Monchengladbach force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
82' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
82' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lukas Kubler.
81' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Here comes a substitution. Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) is brought on as a substitute for Julian Weigl.
78' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Rocco Reitz.
78' The substitution has been made. Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) has replaced Franck Honorat.
76' The attendance is 34000.
74' 7:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
71' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Michael Gregoritsch and he is replaced by Merlin Rohl (Freiburg).
71' Substitution. Vincenzo Grifo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
70' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) is given a yellow card.

69' B. Monchengladbach slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
66' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Lukas Ullrich.
62' That will be all from Robin Hack who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
62' 3 - 1 Lucas Holer (Freiburg) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.

61' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Lukas Ullrich sends a superb cross into the box. Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header low inside the left post, leaving Noah Atubolu beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 2:1.
61' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:5.

58' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.

55' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
53' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Hartmann had an easy-decision to make.
53' It's a nice effort by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Moritz Nicolas. Easy save.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from B. Monchengladbach comes to nothing.
49' 2 - 0 Goal! Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0.
48' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Robert Hartmann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Moritz Nicolas.
41' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Holer (Freiburg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
39' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' The game is interrupted now, Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
37' The total number of attempts is 6:2.

34' The opposition can't get near Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
32' Freiburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
29' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
27' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

27' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Freiburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' A poorly taken free kick by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall. Corner kick. Freiburg will have an opportunity.
25' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) brings his opponent down. Robert Hartmann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Freiburg.
23' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
21' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
19' The free kick from long range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

18' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for an infringement. Freiburg are awarded the free kick.
15' The percentage of ball possession is – 62:38.
12' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
11' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle. Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play. Free kick. Freiburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

10' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Freiburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

7' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
5' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for B. Monchengladbach.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Freiburg will have the kick-off.
Robert Hartmann got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
